desc: Experience unmatched convenience and organization in your workspace with the Wheeler 30 Piece Hex/Torx Benchtop Screwdriver Set. Engineered to be an all-in-one tool assortment, this comprehensive collection contains 10 SAE Hex, 10 Metric Hex and 10 Torx screwdrivers to cover a wide range of common fasteners, guaranteeing you have the right tool for the job. Features include color-coded handles and markings offering quick identification of each screwdriver type and size, ensuring you spend less time searching for the right tool. Textured, rubber over-molded handles fit comfortably in the hand, increasing grip while reducing hand strain. The black phosphate-coated shafts protect against rust and corrosion, giving you peace of mind that your tools will be long-lasting and look great on your bench for years to come. The sturdy benchtop stand ensures that your tools stay organized, preventing tool loss and time spent looking for misplaced tools. The versatile 3-piece modular stand not only keeps the tools organized but also detaches for ultimate portability.
